baseFrontend: 7.9.75 runtime consolidated with a universal manual state editor
label: v76
notes: Every writable state follows common.write and its declared common.type.
Boolean, numeric and string binary controls use type-aware direct values.
Number, string, enum, array, object and mixed states use one native value dialog.
Safety-relevant command states remain expert-only without bypassing ioBroker ACLs.
The writable cell has one deterministic click path; duplicate capture and bubble writes are removed.
changes: Queued writes preserve distinct consecutive commands and deduplicate only identical pending writes.
Direct controls update their local cache only after a successful socket write.
Write-only and not-yet-readable states show a clickable set-value placeholder.
Context-menu value editing obeys the same safety and common.write policy.
